app.name: Herit Clothing
app.positioning: African heritage fashion — traditional fabrics, prints and patterns fused with contemporary cuts. Sold online and from the Ajuwon Market base in Lagos, shipping to customers worldwide. HeritOS is the custom commerce & operations platform that runs the whole business: storefront, admin, market POS and the bespoke craft engine.

audience: Modern Africans and the diaspora who want to wear their culture with pride, plus walk-in customers at the Ajuwon Market stall in Lagos. Primary shoppers are style-conscious adults buying ready-to-wear heritage pieces or commissioning made-to-measure and aso-ebi group orders.
rbacNote: HeritOS spec defines 8 roles with full RBAC; the 5 above are the launch set. Marketing, Support and Wholesale roles are added in later phases.

Product catalogue: grid/list, search, filter by fabric/size/price
Product detail: variants, gallery + zoom, fabric story, care, size guide
Collections & timed drops / lookbook story pages
Cart & guest checkout (no forced account)
Wishlist & notify-me / restock waitlist
Customer account portal: orders, tracking, addresses, measurements
Bespoke / made-to-measure request form
Journal / blog + fabric origin & meaning library (SEO)
Add / edit / delete products with variants & fabric attributes
Rich storytelling fields, care instructions, SEO per product
One-of-a-kind flag (single-qty, auto-retire)
Collections, timed drops, draft / scheduled publish
Real-time stock by variant & location; low-stock alerts
Fabric roll / yardage tracking; one-of-a-kind register
Order list (search, filter, status) + order detail
Status pipeline: paid → production → shipped → delivered
Branded packing slip & invoice; order notes & gift messages
Manual order creation (DM/social sales)
Zone-based shipping rates, free-delivery thresholds, tracking page
Custom-order request → consult → measure → production → fitting → deliver pipeline
Saved customer measurement profiles
Deposit & balance-due tracking with payment links
Aso-ebi / group orders (organiser + many participants)
Fitting appointment scheduler + reminders; tailor assignment
Fast touchscreen POS (phone/tablet) with shared live inventory
Offline mode with auto-sync (PWA)
Cash / transfer / card capture; print or WhatsApp receipt
Daily cash reconciliation (Z-report); staff PIN login
Owner overview dashboard: revenue, orders, AOV, units
Customer list & profiles (orders, LTV, prefs, tags)
Channel split, best/worst sellers, low-stock alerts
Data export (CSV, PDF, XLSX)
Coupon / promo-code engine
Local gateways (Paystack / Flutterwave) + international (Stripe / PayPal)
Multi-currency checkout (₦, $, £); tax / VAT config
Bank transfer + proof-of-payment confirm
Email & WhatsApp transactional + drip flows (cart, win-back, restock)
Auth: email + phone, OTP (SMS/WhatsApp), forgot/reset, guest checkout
Role-based access control; roles & permissions management
General settings, business profile, brand theming (Herit palette/logo/fonts)
NDPA 2023 data-privacy controls; WCAG 2.1 AA; audit log
PWA installable & offline-capable; automated backup & restore

references: Amber gold used with restraint as the one scarce accent
Golden-hour photography, real people, true skin tones, fabric as hero
Lagos / Ajuwon Market in frame where it fits
brand.signatureCandidate: Needle-and-thread craft mark + a single amber accent stitch/underline motif drawn from the logo — to be finalised in design-sop.
brand.logo: Needle-and-thread monogram forming 'HERIT' in cream Source Serif, 'CLOTHING' in amber; supplied on black. Place at apps/web/public/herit-logo.png (light + dark lockups). Min 24px tall on screen; clear space = height of the 'H'.
brand.voice: Warm not salesy, rooted not preachy, modern not slangy, confident not boastful. British/Nigerian English (colour, honour). Capitalise fabric names (Ankara, Adire, Aso-Oke, Kente). Sentence case for headings/buttons; only the wordmark is all-caps.

hosting.notes: Lagos-based, sells globally. Domain & cPanel host to confirm. House stack: React+Vite+TS SPA at apex, Laravel API at api. subdomain, MySQL on cPanel, Cloudflare in front.

constraints: Naira-first but multi-currency (₦ primary, $ and £ for international).
Omnichannel from launch path: online storefront + Ajuwon Market POS sharing one live inventory.
NDPA 2023 (Nigeria Data Protection Act) compliance and WCAG 2.1 AA are Must.
PWA: installable and offline-capable (critical for market POS).
Must run on the DEVGEE house stack (React + Laravel + MySQL on cPanel) and locally before deploy.
Build the 'Must / P1' launch contract first; P2–P5 modules are a sequenced backlog, not launch scope.
Brand is already established — inherit the amber/brown palette, Source Serif 4 + Inter, and the Herit voice; do not invent a new identity.
